name: Yared Tour & Travel
mission: To develop responsible, community-based tourism experiences while showcasing Ethiopia's culture, nature, and history through ethical, respectful travel that generates real income for rural communities.

valuePillars.title: 20+ Years Heritage
valuePillars.description: Operating authentic journeys across Ethiopia since 2004 with deep local roots and respected community ties.

valuePillars.title: Dual Ethiopian & Dutch Presence
valuePillars.description: Local operational mastery in Addis Ababa paired with European customer support and booking reliability from Ubbergen, Netherlands.

valuePillars.title: Travelife Sustainability Partner
valuePillars.description: Rigorous sustainability compliance guaranteeing fair wages, environmental care, and respect for cultural dignity.

valuePillars.title: Direct Community Income
valuePillars.description: Every journey directly benefits local guides, village cooperatives, women-led initiatives, and regional drivers.
